rows.label: Magna Carta
rows.description: charter of rights agreed between King John of England and the nobility in 1215
rows.hook: was sealed by a king at Runnymede after rebel barons forced him to accept limits on his power

rows.label: Domesday Book
rows.description: manuscript record of the "Great Survey" of much of England and parts of Wales completed in 1086
rows.hook: was a vast survey of lands and property ordered by William the Conqueror, named for Judgment Day

rows.label: Louisiana Purchase
rows.description: 1803 acquisition by the U.S. of France's claim to the territory of Louisiana
rows.hook: was a land deal in which a young nation paid $15 million and roughly doubled its size

rows.label: Code of Hammurabi
rows.description: Babylonian code of law or conduct
rows.hook: is an ancient set of laws carved on a black stone pillar, known for its eye-for-an-eye style punishments

rows.label: Gettysburg Address
rows.description: speech by U.S. President Abraham Lincoln
rows.hook: was a short Lincoln speech at a Civil War cemetery, opening "Four score and seven years ago"

rows.label: Ninety-five Theses
rows.description: disputation by Martin Luther on indulgences
rows.hook: is said to have been nailed to a church door by Martin Luther, sparking the Protestant Reformation

rows.label: Articles of Confederation
rows.description: first constitution of the United States (1781–1789)
rows.hook: served as the young republic's first constitution, a weak framework replaced by a stronger one

rows.label: Marshall Plan
rows.description: American initiative for foreign aid to Western Europe following World War II
rows.hook: was the American aid program that helped rebuild Western Europe after World War II

rows.label: Emancipation Proclamation
rows.description: executive order issued by president Abraham Lincoln on January 1, 1863 that freed southern slaves
rows.hook: was issued by Lincoln during the Civil War, declaring enslaved people in rebel states to be free

rows.label: Federalist Papers
rows.description: series of 85 essays arguing in favor of the ratification of the US Constitution
rows.hook: is 85 essays by Hamilton, Madison and Jay, written as Publius to win support for the Constitution

rows.label: Mayflower Compact
rows.description: first governing document of Plymouth Colony
rows.hook: was an agreement signed aboard a ship by Pilgrim settlers before they landed to found a colony

rows.label: Bill of Rights 1689
rows.description: act of the English Parliament guaranteeing certain rights
rows.hook: limited the powers of the monarch and strengthened Parliament after the Glorious Revolution
